verdict.rationale: Intuit documents a QuickBooks Workforce API (GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks, samples) and an auto-provisioned sandbox company, which together allow programmatic, UI-free access to payroll data. However, the documented API use cases cover viewing employees and managing deductions, payslips and pensions, not triggering payroll runs. There is also no CLI, no CI guidance, and no OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404). The in-product 'auto payroll' feature is in-app scheduling and gets no credit here. Missing for 10: headless/CLI tooling, documented ability to run payroll via API, CI/automation guides, machine-readable API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
